summary: TORM plc filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release about a routine capital increase from the exercise of Restricted Share Units under its incentive program. The company issued 215,635 Class A common shares at prices ranging from DKK 0.07 to DKK 144.40 per share. This is a standard equity compensation event, not a transformative special situation. The filing is an ordinary report of issuances pursuant to employee equity plans, with no change in corporate control or strategy. No special-situation analysis applies.
